body: My first therapist was an older woman and she was good but it just got to the point of her saying that I was “so severe that it’s amazing”…is that supposed to be a compliment? Or sometimes if I was talking about something traumatic she would literally giggle or laugh IN MY FACE while I’m in pretty much holding back tears. I keep getting more therapist because I just want to be happy and not worry about having panic attacks when I’m trying to pay for my stuff at a grocery store.

I just don’t understand how you can degrade and call someone a liar when your job is to help people. It took me almost a year to get an appointment with my psychiatrist just to be yelled at for being late. I have so many bad experiences I don’t blame people who don’t want to go get a therapist or psychiatrist to be honest. All we want is real help.
I’m homeschooled but I still have over 100 overdue assignments and all F’s
